rationale: Eligible resident semilocal XC with admitted local AO maps defaults to an exact spatial permutation. Large strict-FP64 RKS owners with at least four AO jets, 512 AOs and 524288 points automatically use tile-aligned bisection on compute-capability 8+ low-FP64-throughput devices. Pure and global-hybrid GGA/meta-GGA share this policy regardless of work jets or exchange fraction; small endpoint gains do not justify functional-specific scheduling. Selector-unset RTX5090 complete E/F qualification includes independent default-grid and resource/graph/moved-geometry/memcheck checks. Unqualified domains retain center grouping. Explicit 1 restores center grouping, 2 requests bounded bisection and 0 retains canonical execution. Canonical force ownership and optional capacity/OOM fallbacks remain unchanged; full-rate FP64, mixed precision, range separation, UKS, nonlocal and explicit reference/public resource promises are not newly promoted.
revisit_condition: Require renewed complete-endpoint, independent observable, canonical force identity and resource/lifetime qualification before broadening the bisection domain or changing quadrature, AO thresholds or precision. Preserve the explicit center/canonical rollback and bounded optional-storage refusal.
